ceu: ✦ The conjunction between the Sun and Jupiter

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.

The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on routine, daily work and health. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Listen to a song you love and let yourself go.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.

The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Light a candle at the end of the day and give thanks for your home.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon livens up short trips and contact with siblings, neighbours and colleagues. A day on the move.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on home and family. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Give a sincere compliment to someone you come across.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today's emotions run through your wallet and through what you consider yours. Protect what you have built, without closing yourself off.

The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Ask for what you are owed, politely and without fear.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon passes through your sign today and leaves your emotions close to the surface: it is a day to listen to yourself first and decide later.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your money and what you value. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Before saying yes to someone, ask yourself whether it is also a yes for you.

t: Today sensitivity is high and tiredness may appear. Sleep well and protect yourself from noise.

The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your image and your personal energy. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Say a short prayer or meditation for your peace.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: With the Moon in your house of dreams, the future feels closer. Write down a wish and a first step.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on rest and your inner life. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Invite someone for a coffee or a walk.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon asks you for responsibility and vision. Think about what you want to build over the coming months.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on friends and plans for the future. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Keep a promise you made to yourself today.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: A day to step out of your mental routine. Try a different path, even a small one.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your career and your goals. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Sign up for, or find out about, a course that interests you.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon passes through your deepest area. Emotions arrive with intensity, and with them the wish for truth.

The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Trust a secret only to someone who has already proved worthy of it.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: Today relationships need attention: a partner, an associate or a close friend needs to feel your presence.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Do not try to change the other person: try to understand them.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: With the Moon in your house of daily work, practical tasks go well. Start with the one you keep putting off.
The Sun and Jupiter are together in {S:5}: willpower and visibility, confidence and opportunities, all focused on relationships and partnerships. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Start the day with the hardest task and the rest will feel light.
